Sukesh Chandrashekhar jailed 8 years for impersonating judge

Conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar has been sentenced to eight years of rigorous imprisonment by a Delhi court. The sentence was handed down in a case where he impersonated a Supreme Court judge. This conviction adds to his existing legal troubles.
